blocks.zh: 分布
blocks.label: subsec:distributions-definition

blocks.en: We now define the space of distributions. As we indicated in the introduction, the definition of a distribution is constructed very cleverly to achieve two seemingly contradictory goals. We wish to have a generalized notion of a "function" that includes objects that are highly singular or "rough." At the same time we wish to be able to define "derivatives" of arbitrary order of these objects.
blocks.zh: 现在定义分布空间. 如引言所述, 分布的定义构造得非常巧妙, 以实现两个看似矛盾的目标. 希望有一个"函数"的广义概念, 其中包含高度奇异或"粗糙"的对象. 同时, 又希望能够定义这些对象的任意阶"导数".

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: A \textbf{distribution} or \textbf{generalized function} is a linear mapping $\phi\mapsto(f,\phi)$ from $\mathcal{D}(\Omega)$ to $\mathbb{R}$, which is continuous in the following sense: If $\phi_n\to\phi$ in $\mathcal{D}(\Omega)$, then $(f,\phi_n)\to(f,\phi)$. The set of all distributions is called $\mathcal{D}^{\prime}(\Omega)$.
blocks.zh: \textbf{分布}或\textbf{广义函数}是从 $\mathcal{D}(\Omega)$ 到 $\mathbb{R}$ 的线性映射 $\phi\mapsto(f,\phi)$, 它在以下意义下连续: 若 $\phi_n\to\phi$ 在 $\mathcal{D}(\Omega)$ 中成立, 则 $(f,\phi_n)\to(f,\phi)$. 所有分布构成的集合称为 $\mathcal{D}^{\prime}(\Omega)$.
blocks.label: def:distribution

blocks.en: Generalized functions like the delta function do not take "values" like ordinary functions. Nevertheless, it is customary to use the language of ordinary functions and speak of "the generalized function $\delta(\bm{x})$,"\footnote{We apologize to those among our friends to whom such language is an abomination --- even for ordinary functions!} even though it does not make sense to plug in a specific $\bm{x}$. We shall also write $\int_\Omega\delta(\bm{x})\phi(\bm{x})\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}$ for $(\delta,\phi)$.
blocks.zh: 像 delta 函数这样的广义函数, 并不像普通函数那样取"值". 尽管如此, 习惯上仍使用普通函数的语言, 谈论"广义函数 $\delta(\bm{x})$",\footnote{对于那些认为这种说法令人厌恶的朋友, 我们表示歉意 --- 即使对普通函数, 他们也认为这种说法令人厌恶!} 即使代入某个具体的 $\bm{x}$ 并没有意义. 也将用 $\int_\Omega\delta(\bm{x})\phi(\bm{x})\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}$ 表示 $(\delta,\phi)$.
blocks.label: rem:generalized-function-point-values

blocks.en: Other singular distributions include such examples from physics as surface charge. If $S$ is a smooth two-dimensional surface in $\mathbb{R}^3$ and $q:S\to\mathbb{R}$ is integrable, then for $\phi\in\mathcal{D}(\mathbb{R}^3)$ we define\[(q,\phi)=\int_Sq(\bm{x})\phi(\bm{x})\,\mathrm{d}a(\bm{x})\]where $\mathrm{d}a(\bm{x})$ indicates integration with respect to surface area on $S$.
blocks.zh: 其他奇异分布包括面电荷这类来自物理学的例子. 若 $S$ 是 $\mathbb{R}^3$ 中光滑的二维曲面, 且 $q:S\to\mathbb{R}$ 可积, 则对 $\phi\in\mathcal{D}(\mathbb{R}^3)$ 定义\[(q,\phi)=\int_Sq(\bm{x})\phi(\bm{x})\,\mathrm{d}a(\bm{x})\]其中 $\mathrm{d}a(\bm{x})$ 表示关于 $S$ 上的曲面面积积分.
blocks.label: ex:surface-charge-distribution

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: A current flowing along a curve $\mathcal{C}\subset\mathbb{R}^3$ is an example of a vector-valued distribution. If $\bm{j}:\mathcal{C}\to\mathbb{R}^3$ is integrable, then for $\bm{\phi}\in\mathcal{D}(\mathbb{R}^3)^3$ we define\[(\bm{j},\bm{\phi})=\int_{\mathcal{C}}\bm{j}(\bm{x})\cdot\bm{\phi}(\bm{x})\,\mathrm{d}\sigma(\bm{x})\]where $\mathrm{d}\sigma(\bm{x})$ indicates integration with respect to arclength on $\mathcal{C}$.
blocks.zh: 沿曲线 $\mathcal{C}\subset\mathbb{R}^3$ 流动的电流是向量值分布的一个例子. 若 $\bm{j}:\mathcal{C}\to\mathbb{R}^3$ 可积, 则对 $\bm{\phi}\in\mathcal{D}(\mathbb{R}^3)^3$ 定义\[(\bm{j},\bm{\phi})=\int_{\mathcal{C}}\bm{j}(\bm{x})\cdot\bm{\phi}(\bm{x})\,\mathrm{d}\sigma(\bm{x})\]其中 $\mathrm{d}\sigma(\bm{x})$ 表示关于 $\mathcal{C}$ 上的弧长积分.
blocks.label: ex:curve-current-distribution

blocks.en: Suppose not. Then for every $n$ there exists $\psi_n$ such that\[|(f,\psi_n)|>n\sum_{|\alpha|\leq n}\max_{\bm{x}\in K}|D^\alpha\psi_n(\bm{x})|.\]Let $\phi_n:=\psi_n/|(f,\psi_n)|$. Then $\phi_n\to0$ in $\mathcal{D}(\Omega)$, but $(f,\phi_n)\equiv1$. This is a contradiction, and the proof is complete.
blocks.zh: 反设不成立. 那么对每个 $n$, 都存在 $\psi_n$, 使\[|(f,\psi_n)|>n\sum_{|\alpha|\leq n}\max_{\bm{x}\in K}|D^\alpha\psi_n(\bm{x})|.\]令 $\phi_n:=\psi_n/|(f,\psi_n)|$. 那么在 $\mathcal{D}(\Omega)$ 中 $\phi_n\to0$, 但 $(f,\phi_n)\equiv1$. 这产生矛盾, 证明完成.

blocks.en: It is in general not possible to define the product of two generalized functions (cf. Problems~\ref{ex:distribution-multiplication-not-continuous}, \ref{ex:delta-approximation-square-divergence}). However, we can define the product of a distribution and a smooth function.

blocks.en: If the graph of a function $f(x)$ is shifted by $h$, one obtains the graph of the function $f(x-h)$, i.e., $x$ is shifted by $-h$. This can be generalized to distributions on $\mathbb{R}^m$.
blocks.zh: 若将函数 $f(x)$ 的图像平移 $h$, 则得到函数 $f(x-h)$ 的图像, 即 $x$ 平移 $-h$. 这一点可推广到 $\mathbb{R}^m$ 上的分布.

blocks.en:
This definition is motivated by the following formal calculation:\[
\begin{aligned}
(\bm{U}f,\phi)&=(f(\bm{U}^{-1}(\bm{x})),\phi(\bm{x}))\\
&=\int_{\mathbb{R}^m}f(\bm{U}^{-1}(\bm{x}))\phi(\bm{x})\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}\\
&=|\det A|\int_{\mathbb{R}^m}f(\bm{y})\phi(\bm{U}(\bm{y}))\,\mathrm{d}\bm{y}.
\end{aligned}
\](We have substituted $\bm{x}=\bm{U}(\bm{y})$.)
blocks.zh:
这一定义的动机来自以下形式计算:\[
\begin{aligned}
(\bm{U}f,\phi)&=(f(\bm{U}^{-1}(\bm{x})),\phi(\bm{x}))\\
&=\int_{\mathbb{R}^m}f(\bm{U}^{-1}(\bm{x}))\phi(\bm{x})\,\mathrm{d}\bm{x}\\
&=|\det A|\int_{\mathbb{R}^m}f(\bm{y})\phi(\bm{U}(\bm{y}))\,\mathrm{d}\bm{y}.
\end{aligned}
\](这里作了代换 $\bm{x}=\bm{U}(\bm{y})$.)

blocks.en: With this definition, we can define the symmetry of a generalized function; for example, $f$ is even if $f(-\bm{x})=f(\bm{x})$, i.e., $(f(\bm{x}),\phi(\bm{x}))=(f(\bm{x}),\phi(-\bm{x}))$.
blocks.zh: 利用这一定义, 可以定义广义函数的对称性; 例如, 若 $f(-\bm{x})=f(\bm{x})$, 即 $(f(\bm{x}),\phi(\bm{x}))=(f(\bm{x}),\phi(-\bm{x}))$, 则 $f$ 为偶的.
blocks.label: rem:distribution-symmetry
